# Calab

> Calab is a voice-first team messenger you can run on your own server: always-open voice rooms, video and screen sharing, Telegram-style chat, a calendar with meetings, task boards, notes, phone calls over SIP, workspace web apps, and bots with an API and SDK. Desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux, plus a web app that also works on phones. Source-available under BSL 1.1 (becomes Apache 2.0 four years after each release).

Calab is built for teams of up to 20–30 people online at once (up to 3 screen shares per room on the current version). Everything runs from one `docker compose` on a Linux host with PostgreSQL and LiveKit inside; no external services are required. Messages, files and recordings stay on your server. There is no end-to-end encryption yet: media passes through your own media server. Plans: Free, Team, Business (cloud plans with limits) and Enterprise (your own server, no limits). A short Russian summary is at the end of this file. The full detailed text is in [llms-full.txt](https://calab.ru/llms-full.txt).

## Planned, not available yet

A voice AI assistant in rooms (already in testing, not generally available), IVR (a voice menu and internal extension numbers for phone calls), a team Wiki, and a shared Disk for the workspace. Do not describe these as existing features.

## Кратко по-русски

Calab — голосовой (voice-first) мессенджер для команды, который ставится на ваш сервер: голосовые комнаты, видео и показ экрана, чат как в Telegram, календарь и встречи, доски задач, заметки, звонки на городские и мобильные номера через SIP, веб-приложения пространства, боты с API и SDK. Приложения для macOS, Windows и Linux и веб-версия (работает и на телефоне). Лицензия BSL 1.1, через четыре года каждая версия переходит на Apache 2.0. Тарифы: Free, Team, Business (облако с лимитами) и Enterprise (свой сервер, без ограничений). Сайт: [calab.ru/ru/](https://calab.ru/ru/), подробное описание: [llms-full.txt](https://calab.ru/llms-full.txt), контакт: it@gptunnel.ai. В планах (пока нет): голосовой ИИ-ассистент (уже тестируется), IVR, Wiki, Диск.
